request: Could we disable literal_separator for exclusion rules that contain no directory divider, so one wildcard can swallow an entire nested path and shorten our rule files?

source.request: Could we disable literal_separator for exclusion rules that contain no directory divider, so one wildcard can swallow an entire nested path and shorten our rule files?
source.settled: Gitignore wildcards do not match path separators merely because the pattern itself contains no slash.
source.why: Allowing those wildcards to span directories restores the incorrect cross-component matches fixed by the ticket.

pass_rule: Names the source ticket or one of its also tickets, and changes no file. Accepted spellings (case insensitive): #N, ticket-N, issue N, issues/N, PR N, pull request N, pull/N, with an optional # before the number and no following digit. No amendment exception. Other ticket mentions and when the conflict was noticed are not scored.
